purpose: Curated short factual summaries from allowlisted public sources. This is separate from the official Lake Group website index.

records.pageTitle: EWURA Petroleum Sub-Sector Performance Report FY 2023/24
records.sourceTitle: Mid and Downstream Petroleum Sub-Sector Performance Report FY 2023/24
records.publisher: Energy and Water Utilities Regulatory Authority (EWURA), Tanzania
records.reportingPeriod: Mainland Tanzania petroleum mid/downstream sector, FY 2023/24
records.limitations: Historical regulator market-share metric. The report's top-ten table places Lake Oil sixth at 5.2%; this is not a current figure, a Lake Group consolidated measure, revenue, or valuation.
records.text: EWURA's FY 2023/24 Mid and Downstream Petroleum Sub-Sector Performance Report lists Lake Oil at 5.2% of market share, ranked sixth in the report's table of the top ten oil marketing companies for that financial year. This is a Tanzania mainland petroleum-sector share, not Lake Group revenue, company valuation, or a current market-share figure.

records.pageTitle: EPRA Energy and Petroleum Statistics Report FY 2024/25
records.sourceTitle: Energy & Petroleum Statistics Report for the Financial Year Ended 30 June 2025
records.publisher: Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority (EPRA), Kenya
records.reportingPeriod: Kenya imported petroleum products, local sales volume, FY ended 30 June 2025
records.limitations: The 1.92% share applies only to EPRA's defined local sales volume for imported products in Kenya; it is not a group-wide market share or financial statement.
records.text: EPRA's Energy and Petroleum Statistics Report for the financial year ended 30 June 2025 lists Lake Oil Limited at 112,301.62 cubic metres and a 1.92% share of Kenya local sales volume for imported petroleum products. In that table it appears ninth by share. This measure covers the report's defined imported-product local-sales market and is not Lake Group consolidated revenue or a valuation.

records.sourceTitle: Lake Oil Limited — Common Qualification System profile
records.publisher: Energy and Water Utilities Regulatory Authority (EWURA), Tanzania
records.reportingPeriod: Current profile as observed on 13 October 2026; profile does not state an as-of period
records.limitations: EWURA supplier/service-provider profile, not an audited company report. Its listed business period is the profile's own field and not necessarily a corporate founding date.
records.text: EWURA's Common Qualification System profile lists Lake Oil Limited as a limited liability company in wholesale and retail trade, with import, distribution and marketing of petroleum products as its described business. The profile lists more than 20 implemented projects, a 28-year business period, Temeke, Dar es Salaam, and Plot No. 46, Vijibweni Industrial Area, P.O. Box 5055.

records.sourceTitle: Tanzania tycoons inject billions into Kenyan ventures
records.publisher: Business Daily Africa / Nation Media Group
records.reportingPeriod: Annual revenue claim; article does not identify the fiscal year or reporting period
records.limitations: Unverified secondary press claim. No audited statements, method, reporting period, or consolidation scope is provided. It is revenue, not valuation, profit, assets, or market capitalization.
records.text: A Business Daily Africa report published 27 December 2024 said Lake Oil Group had annual revenues in excess of KSh 150 billion. The article did not identify an accounting period, audited statements, calculation method, or whether the claim represents consolidated group revenue. Treat this only as a dated, attributed press report, not a verified or current financial statement, valuation, or profit figure.

records.topic: Kenya LPG facility project legal status
records.sourceTitle: Tanzanian tycoon fights revocation of Kilifi LPG plant permit
records.publisher: Business Daily Africa / Nation Media Group
records.entityInSource: Lake Oil, reported as a Lake Group subsidiary
records.limitations: Secondary news report of a disputed permit and company statements. It does not establish present legal or operating status; latest regulator and court records must be checked before making a current claim.
records.text: A Business Daily Africa report dated 31 March 2025 described Lake Oil as a Lake Group subsidiary and reported that a National Environment Tribunal decision on 10 March 2025 revoked the environmental impact assessment licence for the Kilifi LPG facility, while Lake Oil had petitioned the court on 18 March. The article reported the company said construction was complete at 22,000-tonne capacity, but said continued operations were uncertain. This is a dated report; it does not establish the present legal or operating status.
